'''Phateem''' was an [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] which housed a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] library and storehouse known as the [[Halls of Knowledge/Legends|Halls of Knowledge]],<ref name="TEA" /> within the planet's [[Ashlendu Mountains/Legends|Ashlendu]] [[Mountain/Legends|Mountains]].<ref name="FaDCR" />
